name: Dirichlet character modulo q
definition: Completely multiplicative periodic function chi with chi(n)=0 when gcd(n,q)>1.
pvg_view: Residue-channel phase label attached after decoding a valuation vector modulo q.

name: character orthogonality
statement: For reduced residues a,b mod q, sum_chi chi(a) conjugate(chi(b)) = phi(q) if a=b mod q, else 0.

name: residue indicator expansion
statement: 1_{n=a mod q, gcd(a,q)=1}=phi(q)^(-1) sum_chi conjugate(chi(a)) chi(n).

name: Dirichlet L-function
definition: L(s,chi)=sum_{n>=1} chi(n)n^{-s} for Re(s)>1, with Euler product there.
pvg_view: Character-weighted log-height transform over valuation vectors.

name: character-weighted von Mangoldt sum
pvg_view: Phase-weighted sum over single-axis prime-power points.

name: PNT in arithmetic progressions boundary
statement: Character decomposition organizes residue classes but does not by itself prove zero-free regions or PNT in AP.

name: GRH boundary
statement: A residue-phase PVG representation does not determine the real parts of zeros of L(s,chi).

claim: exact residue-channel translation yields analytic continuation
